meta.name: formax-skill-capture
meta.description: Use when we want to turn a just-finished Formax workflow (e.g. commands, overlays, tools, hooks, permissions, UI parity) into a reusable Codex Skill under .codex/skills, including scaffolding, guardrails, and the minimum test checklist.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将刚完成的Formax工作流转为可复用的Codex技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常需要把Formax工作流封装成可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Turn a finished Formax workflow into a reusable Codex skill
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to package Formax workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: 当完成一个Formax工作流后，Claude能将它自动转为.codex/skills下的可复用技能，包括文件映射、模式、测试清单和防护规则。
howto.when: 当你说“把这个流程沉淀成skill”、“以后别再忘了怎么改/xxx”或“给我一个复用的修改清单/固定套路”时触发。

say.note: Claude会询问技能名称、描述等信息。

say.text: 给我一个复用的修改清单/固定套路
say.note: Claude会生成对应的技能模板。

howto.what_en: After completing a Formax workflow, Claude can convert it into a reusable skill under .codex/skills, including file maps, patterns, test checklists, and guardrails.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'turn this workflow into a skill', 'never forget how to change /xxx again', or 'give me a reusable checklist/fixed routine'.

say_en.text: Turn this workflow into a skill
say_en.note: Claude will ask for skill name, description, etc.

say_en.text: Give me a reusable checklist/fixed routine
say_en.note: Claude will generate the corresponding skill template.
